description: UC Merced — strong OOS applicant, RD
rationale: UCM anchor ~0.88 (near open-access). The 2026-05-31 audit removed CA from the strong-residency OOS-penalty set: UCs admit OOS *easier*, not harder (#312), so the old flat ×0.5 OOS penalty was wrong. UC Merced actively recruits OOS; a strong OOS applicant at an ~88%-admit school is near-certain, so the result rises to the 0.98 clamp. Range [0.72, 0.98].
